description:
A personal SFTP server for Windows with per-user folders, password or key sign-in, and live connection monitoring.

Simple SFTP Server is a personal SFTP server for Windows. Pick a folder, add a user or use Quick Start, and hand someone a ready-to-paste connection card. Each user is locked to their own folder and signs in by password or public key, with per-user permissions for listing, upload, download, delete, and rename. Watch connections and transfers live. Secure SSH connections only, and everything stays on your machine.
